message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to a particular class (often labeled as 0 or 1) by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model estimates parameters (weights) that maximize the likelihood of observing the training data. Once trained, logistic regression can predict the probability of class membership for new data points, and a threshold (commonly 0.5) is used to assign a final class label.
